meta.title: AU to nm Converter — Astronomical Unit to Nanometer
meta.description: Convert Astronomical Unit (AU) to Nanometer (nm) instantly. 1 AU = 1.495979e+20 nm. Free, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Convert astronomical units (AU) to nanometers (nm) instantly. Both measure length, so the relationship is strictly linear: each astronomical unit equals 1.495979e+20 nanometers. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One astronomical unit is equal to **1.495979e+20 nanometers**. To go the other way, one nanometer equals **6.684587e-21 astronomical units**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> nanometers = astronomical units × 1.495979e+20

Worked example — converting 10 astronomical units:

10 × 1.495979e+20 = **1.495979e+21 nm**.

To invert, divide by 1.495979e+20 (or multiply by 6.684587e-21).
content.use_cases:
- Cooking and recipe conversions when switching between metric and imperial measurements.
- Travel planning where signage and maps use different unit systems.
- DIY and home-improvement projects that mix metric materials with imperial tools.
- Fitness tracking when devices report in one system and goals are set in another.
- Shipping and logistics where weight and dimensions drive cost.
content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 AU ≈ 1.495979e+20 nm. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. Astronomical Unit and Nanometer both measure length; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
content.faq:
**Q:** How many nanometers are in 1 astronomical unit?
**A:** 1.495979e+20 nanometers.

**Q:** What's the formula to convert AU to nm?
**A:** nanometers = astronomical units × 1.495979e+20.

**Q:** How do I convert nm back to AU?
**A:** Multiply by 6.684587e-21 (or divide by 1.495979e+20).

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
**A:** For most everyday uses, yes. For scientific or engineering work, use the full precision from the converter.

**Q:** Does this AU to nm converter work offline?
**A:** Yes — all math runs in your browser, no network required after the page loads.
